name: SandBase Harness
summary: Local-first Apache-2.0 agent runtime with sandboxed sessions, memory, credentials, MCP toolsets, audit/replay and a local Console.
description: Open-source self-hosted runtime (sandbaseai/sandbase-harness; not archived; Apache-2.0). README and llms.txt describe persistent sessions, credential vaults, permission policies, MCP toolsets and sandbox backends (local process, Docker, Kubernetes, self-hosted workers). Latest tagged release cited in the project's llms.txt: v0.3.8 (verified 2026-11-10). Local-first SQLite/file storage; no hosted control plane is required. Also referred to in-repo as managed-agents; README warns to install only from official paths once a scoped package is announced. Sandboxes can run generated code and reach external services — isolation and permissions are the operator's responsibility. Model-provider credentials and compute are separate. Same operator family as the hosted SandBase service and sandbase-skills (AXIOMCLOUD / sandbaseai).

agent_access.notes: Public source and llms-install.md. Optional model-provider and SandBase keys are configured separately.
